text:
miri: Hey team — new user hitting our Node quickstart, first call returns 402. UI shows 'Set payment method' on the workspace. But quickstart docs say first call should work with free trial. Anyone seen this?

alex: Do you have the exact curl/SDK payload and the workspace id? 402 usually means billing required (payment method missing).

miri: workspace: rdw-newcorp-42. curl I ran: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \\ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.0","input":"hello"}'
```
response: 
```
{
  "error": {
    "code": 402,
    "message": "Workspace payment method required: workspace rdw-newcorp-42"
  }
}
```

sam: hmm — we changed the onboarding policy last quarter to require a payment method for production-tier models to curb abuse. We should have updated the quickstart wording. For now you can either add a payment method or use the dev-preview model that isn't gated.

miri: Is there a dev-preview model name I can recommend in the quickstart? Users will expect first-call friction-free.

sam: use "redwood-mini-preview" for testing — it's free for the first 1k tokens and not blocked by billing. Example Node snippet: 
```js
// quickstart override for onboarding users
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });

const resp = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'redwood-mini-preview',
  input: 'hey'
});
console.log(resp.output[0].content[0].text);
```

jess: Billing note: we intentionally removed the one-call grace period because of repeated abuse from bot farms. We can add a product flag that allows a single sample call for verified email domains (edu/org) — would that help? cc @alex-pm

alex: That could be a good compromise. In the meantime, devex team should: 1) update quickstart to mention dev-preview fallback, 2) add a small troubleshooting blurb in onboarding about "402 → add payment method or use preview model".

miri: I updated the quickstart PR with the fallback example and added a short troubleshooting section. Trying the preview model now...

miri: SUCCESS — switched to redwood-mini-preview and got a 200. Response: 
```
{
  "id":"resp_01",
  "output":[{"content":[{"type":"output_text","text":"hello!"}]}]
}
```

devex-bot: Heads-up: runbook link added to the onboarding guide -> https://go/release/runbooks/onboarding-billing-blocks

sam: Thanks for verifying. Let's track the product flag in the backlog and make sure docs are explicit. :thumbsup:

jess: filing a billing-policy follow-up ticket. Noted: reduce confusion in the console UI so 'Set payment method' has a tooltip mentioning production model gating.

miri: Great — closing this thread. Leaving the quickstart PR link in comments.
